author: Little Hanzi assisted editorial draft; attributed Mandarin and child-suitability review pending

lessons.title: Count our steps
lessons.welcome: Count a few steps with our capybara. Then read the characters for one and two.

characters.hint: Notice the single horizontal stroke in 一.

words.translation: We pack our school bags together.
We keep walking forwards.

characters.hint: Compare the two horizontal strokes of 二 with 一.

words.translation: I find my seat in the second row.

words.sentence: 二月里，我们在家做纸花。
words.translation: In February, we make paper flowers at home.

lessons.title: A spring calendar
lessons.welcome: Our capybara checks a spring calendar and draws a triangle. Notice three and four in useful words.

characters.hint: Count the three horizontal strokes of 三; then read the whole character.

words.sentence: 三月里，小草慢慢长出来。
words.translation: In March, little blades of grass slowly grow.
We fold the paper into a triangle.

characters.hint: Notice the outer box and the two marks inside 四.

words.sentence: 这本书介绍四季的变化。
words.translation: This book introduces changes through the four seasons.

words.sentence: 四月里，我们在花园散步。
words.translation: In April, we walk in the garden.

lessons.title: Summer plans
lessons.welcome: Our capybara makes summer plans. Find five and six in month names and a six-sided pattern.

characters.hint: Look at how the middle strokes join the top and bottom of 五.

words.translation: In May, we water the flowers.
There is a kitten on the fifth page.

characters.hint: Notice the top dot and the two spreading strokes below 六.

words.sentence: 六月里，我们到公园野餐。
words.translation: In June, we have a picnic in the park.

words.sentence: 我们画了一个六角图案。
words.translation: We draw a six-sided pattern.

lessons.title: A summer kitchen
lessons.welcome: Our capybara looks at a summer calendar and a spice in the kitchen. Meet seven and eight in words.

characters.hint: Notice the horizontal stroke crossing the turning stroke in 七.

words.sentence: 七月里，我们读一本新书。
words.translation: In July, we read a new book.

words.sentence: 七夕晚上，我们一起看星星。
words.translation: On the evening of Qixi, we look at the stars together.

characters.hint: The two strokes of 八 spread apart; compare them with 人.

words.sentence: 八月里，我们给朋友写信。
words.translation: In August, we write a letter to a friend.
There is a small bag of star anise in the kitchen.

lessons.title: Read the clock
lessons.welcome: Our capybara plans a library visit. Read nine on the clock and ten in useful expressions.

characters.hint: Notice the bending stroke in 九 and compare its whole shape with 七.

words.sentence: 九月里，我们整理新的课本。
words.translation: In September, we organise our new textbooks.
We go to the library at nine o'clock.

characters.hint: One horizontal and one vertical stroke cross in 十.

words.sentence: 十月里，我们捡起落叶做拼贴。
words.translation: In October, we collect fallen leaves for a collage.
This little rabbit is very cute.

lessons.title: Measure a route
lessons.welcome: Our capybara measures a route and weighs a bag. Compare words about hundreds and thousands.

characters.hint: Compare 百 with 白 and notice the extra horizontal stroke at the top.

words.sentence: 操场上有一条百米跑道。
words.translation: There is a one-hundred-metre running track on the playground.

words.sentence: 故事里的百姓一起修桥。
words.translation: The ordinary people in the story build a bridge together.

characters.hint: Look at the sloping top stroke of 千; compare it with 十.

words.sentence: 从这里到公园有一千米。
words.translation: It is one kilometre from here to the park.
This bag of rice weighs one kilogram.

lessons.title: A cheer and a forecast
lessons.welcome: Our capybara packs for uncertain weather and enjoys a cheer. Meet ten thousand and zero in expressions.

characters.hint: Notice the long top stroke and the turning stroke beneath 万.

words.sentence: 万一下雨，我们就带上雨伞。
words.translation: We take an umbrella in case it rains.

words.sentence: 比赛结束，孩子们开心地喊万岁。
words.translation: After the game, the children happily cheer hooray.

characters.hint: Find the rain-shaped top of 零 and look carefully at its lower strokes.

words.sentence: 我们把零食放进野餐篮。
words.translation: We put snacks into the picnic basket.

words.sentence: 天气预报说明天是零下两度。
words.translation: The weather forecast says tomorrow will be two degrees below zero.

lessons.title: A card for our parents
lessons.welcome: Our capybara makes a card for a family visit. Read two friendly words for each parent character.

characters.hint: Notice 父 above 巴 in 爸; use the whole printed shape.

words.sentence: 爸爸陪我读一本故事书。
words.translation: Dad reads a storybook with me.
I say good morning to Dad.

characters.hint: Notice 女 on the left of 妈 and compare the whole shape with 马.

words.translation: Mum and I plant flowers together.

words.sentence: 我给老妈画了一张卡片。
words.translation: I draw a card for Mum.

lessons.title: Older siblings help
lessons.welcome: Our capybara meets older siblings who help with pencils and paper boats. Look at their family words.

characters.hint: Notice the repeated shapes in 哥 and the small hooks on the right.

words.translation: My older brother helps me find my pencil.

words.sentence: 故事里的大哥照顾弟妹。
words.translation: The eldest brother in the story looks after his younger siblings.

characters.hint: Notice 女 on the left and the stacked lines on the right of 姐.

words.translation: My older sister teaches me to fold a paper boat.

words.sentence: 大姐带大家一起做游戏。
words.translation: The eldest sister leads everyone in a game.

lessons.title: Younger siblings play
lessons.welcome: Our capybara plays with younger siblings. Read words about brothers and sisters.

characters.hint: Notice the two top marks and the long stroke through 弟.

words.translation: My younger brother puts the blocks back in the box.

words.sentence: 故事里的兄弟一起寻找小狗。
words.translation: The brothers in the story look for the puppy together.

characters.hint: Compare 妹 and 姐: their left parts match, but their right parts differ.

words.translation: My younger sister draws wings on the little bird.

words.sentence: 这对姐妹喜欢一起读书。
words.translation: These sisters enjoy reading together.

lessons.title: A visit with grandparents
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits grandparents for stories, bread and milk. Notice the family words in ordinary print.

characters.hint: Compare 爷 and 爸: both have 父 at the top, with different lower parts.

words.sentence: 爷爷给我们讲小时候的故事。
words.translation: Grandpa tells us stories about his childhood.

words.sentence: 公园里的老爷爷在看报纸。
words.translation: An elderly man in the park is reading a newspaper.

characters.hint: Notice 女 on the left of 奶; compare its right part with 妈.

words.translation: Grandma and I make bread together.
There is warm milk in the cup.

lessons.title: At the farm
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits a farm. Meet horses and cattle through useful words.

characters.hint: Look at the turning strokes and the final horizontal stroke of 马.

words.sentence: 故事里的马车停在桥边。
words.translation: The horse-drawn carriage in the story stops beside the bridge.

words.sentence: 农场里的马匹正在吃草。
words.translation: The horses on the farm are eating grass.

characters.hint: Notice the long middle stroke crossing the horizontal strokes in 牛.

words.translation: A water buffalo rests beside the pond.
We pour milk into a cup.

lessons.title: Sheep and a friendly dog
lessons.welcome: Our capybara sees sheep, goats and a friendly dog. Compare their printed characters.

characters.hint: Notice the two small top strokes and the middle line of 羊.

words.translation: A goat stands on a little hillside.
A sheep walks slowly across the grass.

characters.hint: Notice the narrow left part and the small box on the right of 狗.

words.translation: The puppy wags its tail by the doorway.

words.sentence: 我们把狗窝里的垫子放好。
words.translation: We arrange the cushion in the dog's kennel.

lessons.title: A cat and a fish tank
lessons.welcome: Our capybara watches a kitten and a fish tank. Read two words for each animal character.
lessons.readerTitle: A cat and a fish tank

characters.hint: Compare the left parts of 猫 and 狗; then notice 田 inside 猫.

words.translation: The kitten enjoys the sunshine by the window.

words.sentence: 猫咪安静地躺在垫子上。
words.translation: The kitty lies quietly on the cushion.

characters.hint: Notice the top part, the central box and the long lower stroke of 鱼.

words.translation: The goldfish swims slowly in the water.

words.sentence: 我们观察鱼缸里的小鱼。
words.translation: We watch the little fish in the fish tank.

lessons.title: Rabbits and chicks
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits rabbits and chicks. Notice the small differences in their character shapes.

characters.hint: Find the small lower dot in 兔 and compare the whole shape with 免.

words.sentence: 兔子在草地上跳了一下。
words.translation: The rabbit makes a little hop on the grass.
The white rabbit lifts its long ears.

characters.hint: Notice 鸟 on the right of 鸡 and the crossing strokes on the left.

words.translation: The rooster stands beside the fence.
The chick slowly follows its mother.

lessons.title: Birds beside the pond
lessons.welcome: Our capybara watches birds beside a pond. Read words for ducks, a feather and a swan.

characters.hint: Notice 鸟 on the right of 鸭 and compare its left part with 田.

words.translation: A duck swims in the pond.
We watch the wild duck from a distance.

characters.hint: Notice 鸟 on the right of 鹅 and look carefully at the strokes on the left.

words.sentence: 地上有一根白色的鹅毛。
words.translation: There is a white goose feather on the ground.
A swan swims across the lake.

lessons.title: Rice for dinner
lessons.welcome: Our capybara helps set the table. Compare uncooked rice with words for cooked rice and meals.

characters.hint: The strokes of 米 spread around a central crossing; compare it with 木.

words.translation: There is a bag of uncooked rice in the kitchen.
There is warm cooked rice in the bowl.

characters.hint: Notice the narrow food-shaped left part of 饭 and the different right part.

words.translation: We serve the cooked rice into small bowls.
After dinner, we take a walk together.

lessons.title: Fruit and vegetables
lessons.welcome: Our capybara packs a basket of fruit and vegetables. Read familiar foods in ordinary print.

characters.hint: Notice 田 above 木 in 果; read the whole character.

words.translation: We wash the fruit clean.
There is a red apple on the table.

characters.hint: Notice the grass-shaped top of 菜 and compare it with 花.

words.sentence: 篮子里装着新鲜的蔬菜。
words.translation: The basket holds fresh vegetables.
We put Chinese cabbage in the soup.

lessons.title: Beans and a warm meal
lessons.welcome: Our capybara sees beans, tofu and a warm meal. Notice the two food characters in words.

characters.hint: Notice the small box between the upper and lower strokes of 豆.

words.translation: We pour the beans into a bowl.
There are several pieces of tofu on the plate.

characters.hint: Look at the two small 人-like shapes inside 肉; compare its outer lines with 内.

words.translation: There is a small piece of pork in the kitchen.
An adult puts the slices of meat into the pot.

lessons.title: Eggs and bread
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits the kitchen for eggs, noodles and bread. Read the target characters inside each word.

characters.hint: Notice 虫 at the bottom of 蛋 and the different strokes above it.

words.translation: There are six chicken eggs in the box.
The egg yolk is yellow.

characters.hint: Look at the inner lines enclosed by the outer shape of 面.

words.translation: The noodles in the bowl are warm.

words.sentence: 我们把面包放在盘子里。
words.translation: We put the bread on a plate.

lessons.title: A picnic basket
lessons.welcome: Our capybara packs a picnic and sees a grown-up making tea. Read words for melons, cucumbers and tea.

characters.hint: Look closely at the central marks inside the spreading strokes of 瓜.

words.translation: An adult cuts the watermelon into small pieces.
We wash a cucumber.

characters.hint: Notice the grass-shaped top of 茶 and the strokes beneath it.

words.sentence: 茶叶放在一个小盒子里。
words.translation: The tea leaves are kept in a little box.

words.sentence: 爸爸给自己泡了一杯红茶。
words.translation: Dad makes himself a cup of black tea.

lessons.title: Our cosy home
lessons.welcome: Our capybara explores a cosy home. Read words about a house, roof and rooms.

characters.hint: Notice the covering shape at the top and 至 underneath in 屋.

words.translation: The light is on inside the house.
A little bird rests on the roof.

characters.hint: Notice 户 above 方 in 房 and compare its top with 屋.

words.translation: We tidy the room.

words.sentence: 厨房里传来面包的香味。
words.translation: The smell of bread comes from the kitchen.

lessons.title: Ready to go outside
lessons.welcome: Our capybara gets ready to go outside. Find clothes and shoes in useful words.

characters.hint: Notice the top dot and the spreading lower strokes of 衣.

words.sentence: 我们把干净的衣服叠好。
words.translation: We fold the clean clothes.
There is a top on the chair.

characters.hint: Look at 革 on the left of 鞋 and the repeated 土 shapes on the right.

words.translation: I put my shoes beside the door.
I put on my trainers and go to the playground.

lessons.title: Books in a school bag
lessons.welcome: Our capybara packs books and a notebook. Notice the character used when counting books.

characters.hint: Notice the long middle stroke and the upper dot of 书.

words.translation: We put the books back on the shelf.

words.sentence: 我的书包里有一本故事书。
words.translation: There is a storybook in my school bag.

characters.hint: Compare 本 with 木 and notice the extra short line near the bottom.

words.sentence: 我在本子上画了一棵树。
words.translation: I draw a tree in the notebook.
The books are arranged neatly on the table.

lessons.title: Paper and a pencil
lessons.welcome: Our capybara makes a drawing. Read words for paper, pencils and a writing brush.

characters.hint: Notice the narrow thread-shaped left part of 纸 and the strokes on the right.

words.sentence: 我们把纸张整齐地放好。
words.translation: We stack the sheets of paper neatly.

words.sentence: 我用纸巾擦干桌上的水。
words.translation: I use a tissue to wipe the water off the table.

characters.hint: Look at the bamboo-shaped top of 笔 and the turning stroke beneath it.

words.translation: I draw a flower with a pencil.

words.sentence: 老师用毛笔写了一个大字。
words.translation: The teacher writes a large character with a writing brush.

lessons.title: An umbrella and a bag
lessons.welcome: Our capybara gets ready for a rainy walk. Read umbrella and bag in everyday words.

characters.hint: Notice 人 above the spreading inner strokes of 伞.

words.translation: We take an umbrella when it rains.

words.sentence: 妈妈打伞陪我走到门口。
words.translation: Mum holds an umbrella and walks with me to the doorway.

characters.hint: Look at the turning outer stroke of 包 and the smaller shape inside.

words.translation: I hang my school bag on the chair.
There is a slice of bread on the plate.

lessons.title: A place to sit
lessons.welcome: Our capybara arranges a place to sit. Read table and chair words, including wheelchair.

characters.hint: Notice 木 at the bottom of 桌 and the shapes above it.

words.translation: There is a cup of water on the table.
I read at the desk.

characters.hint: Notice 木 on the left of 椅 and compare its right side with 桌.

words.translation: We place the chairs beside the table.

words.sentence: 我们给坐轮椅的朋友留出通道。
words.translation: We leave a clear path for our friend who uses a wheelchair.

lessons.title: Bedtime lights
lessons.welcome: Our capybara gets ready for bedtime. Read words for a bed and lights.

characters.hint: Notice the covering shape above 木 in 床.

words.translation: There are little blue flowers on the bed sheet.

words.sentence: 早上，我起床后整理床铺。
words.translation: In the morning, I get out of bed and make the bed.

characters.hint: Notice 火 on the left of 灯 and the simpler strokes on the right.

words.translation: The desk lamp lights up my book.
The street lights come on after dark.

lessons.title: Red and yellow things
lessons.welcome: Our capybara looks for red and yellow things. Notice the colour characters in familiar words.

characters.hint: Notice the thread-shaped left part of 红 and 工 on the right.

words.sentence: 我用红色的笔画了一颗心。
words.translation: I draw a heart with a red pen.
A red flower blooms in the garden.

characters.hint: Notice the middle box and the lower spreading strokes of 黄.

words.translation: This little toy car is yellow.
There is a cucumber in the basket.

lessons.title: Blue and green outside
lessons.welcome: Our capybara looks at the sky and leaves. Read blue and green in ordinary print.

characters.hint: Notice the grass-shaped top of 蓝 and the wide lower part.

words.translation: I choose a sheet of blue paper.
White clouds drift slowly across the blue sky.

characters.hint: Compare the left parts of 绿 and 红; then look at their different right parts.

words.translation: The little blades of grass in spring are green.
The little bird hides behind the green leaves.

lessons.title: Clouds and a blackboard
lessons.welcome: Our capybara watches clouds and visits a classroom. Compare white and black in words.

characters.hint: Find the upper sloping stroke of 白 and compare the whole shape with 日.

words.translation: This little rabbit has white fur.

words.sentence: 我们躺在草地上看白云。
words.translation: We lie on the grass and look at the white clouds.

characters.hint: Look at the four small lower marks of 黑 and the shapes above them.

words.sentence: 这只小猫的尾巴是黑色的。
words.translation: This kitten's tail is black.

words.sentence: 老师在黑板上画了一只鸟。
words.translation: The teacher draws a bird on the blackboard.

lessons.title: A meal and a drink
lessons.welcome: Our capybara stops for a meal and a drink. Read words about eating and drinking.

characters.hint: Notice 口 on the left of 吃 and the turning stroke on the right.

words.translation: We sit down and eat a meal together.
When I have eaten enough, I put my bowl away.

characters.hint: Compare the 口 on the left of 喝 and 吃; look at the whole right part.

words.translation: After exercise, I sit down and drink water.
Grandpa sits at the table and drinks tea.

lessons.title: Walk, then run
lessons.welcome: Our capybara walks to the park and visits a running track. Compare walk and run in words.

characters.hint: Notice 土 at the top of 走 and the spreading lower strokes.

words.sentence: 我们走路去附近的公园。
words.translation: We walk to the nearby park.
The kitten slowly moves away from the doorway.

characters.hint: Notice the foot-shaped left part of 跑 and 包 on the right.

words.sentence: 我和朋友在操场上跑步。
words.translation: My friend and I run on the playground.
Everyone waits beside the running track.

lessons.title: Look and listen
lessons.welcome: Our capybara looks at a book and listens for birds. Read words about seeing and hearing.

characters.hint: Notice 目 below the upper strokes of 看.

words.translation: I sit by the window and read a book.
We see a little bird.

characters.hint: Notice 口 on the left and 斤 on the right of 听.

words.sentence: 我听见窗外的小鸟在唱歌。
words.translation: I hear a little bird singing outside the window.

words.sentence: 我听说图书馆有一本新书。
words.translation: I hear that the library has a new book.

lessons.title: Read and write
lessons.welcome: Our capybara reads a sentence and writes a card. Notice read and write in ordinary print.

characters.hint: Notice the speech-shaped left part of 读; compare it with 写.

words.translation: We read in the shade of the tree.

words.sentence: 老师请我朗读这一句话。
words.translation: The teacher asks me to read this sentence aloud.

characters.hint: Notice the covering top and the strokes beneath it in 写.

words.translation: I carefully write characters in my notebook.

words.sentence: 这张卡片是我自己书写的。
words.translation: I write this card myself.

lessons.title: Feelings in a story
lessons.welcome: Our capybara reads a story about feelings. Notice words about smiling, laughter and crying.

characters.hint: Notice the bamboo-shaped top of 笑 and the spreading lower strokes.

words.translation: My friend smiles at me.

words.sentence: 院子里传来孩子们的笑声。
words.translation: The sound of children laughing comes from the yard.

characters.hint: Notice the two 口 shapes above the lower strokes in 哭.

words.sentence: 故事里的孩子难过地哭泣。
words.translation: The child in the story cries sadly.

words.sentence: 妈妈听到哭声，就走过来安慰孩子。
words.translation: Mum hears crying and comes over to comfort the child.

lessons.title: A windy, snowy day
lessons.welcome: Our capybara watches a windy, snowy day. Read words for wind, a kite and snowflakes.

characters.hint: Look at the crossing strokes inside the outer shape of 风.

words.sentence: 大风吹动了树上的叶子。
words.translation: A strong wind moves the leaves on the tree.
We fly a kite in an open space.

characters.hint: Notice the rain-shaped top of 雪 and compare its lower part with 零.

words.sentence: 今天下雪，我们在窗边看雪花。
words.translation: It is snowing today, and we watch the snowflakes by the window.

words.sentence: 一片雪花落在我的手套上。
words.translation: A snowflake lands on my glove.
